name: FFS_CATALOG_SCM
description: Represents the integration of a Supply Chain Management (SCM) catalog into Oracle Field Service (OFS).

columns.name: CATALOG_SCM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the SCM catalog.

columns.name: SRC_TYPE
columns.description: Type of source from which the catalog is imported, e.g., SCM Item Catalog or SCM Inventory Organization.

columns.name: SRC_LOCATOR
columns.description: Unique identifier or locator for the catalog source, like a code or label identifying the source within the SCM system. Can be formatted in plain text of JSON.

columns.name: CATALOG_NAME
columns.description: Desired catalog name in Oracle Field Service (OFS).

columns.name: CATALOG_LABEL
columns.description: Desired catalog label in Oracle Field Service (OFS).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: ENABLED
columns.description: Flag that indicates the active status of the catalog integration, determining whether the integration is enabled (active) or disabled (inactive).

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_CONFIG
columns.description: JSON-formatted string for extended configuration options of the integration.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
